title: Could not see App Store Connect: Apple sign-in is not active in this Chrome, so the Paid Apps agreement, banking/tax, subscriptions, TestFlight, privacy label and version page are unchecked
evidence: https://appstoreconnect.apple.com/apps/6821190920 redirected to appstoreconnect.apple.com/login?targetUrl=%2Fapps%2F6821190920&authResult=FAILED and showed the Apple sign-in box (email prefilled, Continue button)
fix: Sign in to App Store Connect in Chrome (Apple ID and two-factor code), then re-run this check; or open Business > Agreements and confirm Paid Apps is Active with banking and tax complete

title: RevenueCat cannot confirm the two Apple subscription products exist in App Store Connect
evidence: RevenueCat Product catalog > Products > Pexi (App Store): Pexi Plus Yearly (pexi_plus_yearly) and Pexi Plus Monthly (pexi_plus_monthly) both show status 'Could not check'; each has '1 Entitlement', created Oct 10, 2026
fix: In App Store Connect confirm both product IDs exist, are at least Ready to Submit with EN and FR localizations and a review screenshot; then add the App Store Connect API key (the .p8 'App Store Connect API' field in the RevenueCat app page is empty) so RevenueCat can verify and import them

title: Apple server notifications have never reached RevenueCat
evidence: RevenueCat Apps > Pexi (App Store) > Apple Server to Server notification settings: 'Apple Server Notification URL  No notifications received'; 'Track new purchases from server-to-server notifications' checkbox unticked. App Store Connect side (App Information URLs) not seen
fix: In App Store Connect > App Information, paste the RevenueCat Apple Server Notification URL (Reveal button in RevenueCat) into both Production and Sandbox Server URL fields (Version 2); renewals, cancellations and refunds will not update access until this is set

title: RevenueCat has no App Store Connect API key, so product import and price sync are off
evidence: RevenueCat Apps > Pexi (App Store) > 'App Store Connect API' section: 'P8 key file from App Store Connect *  Drop a file here, or click to select' (empty). The separate 'In-app purchase key configuration' section shows H45CN4BUF3.p8 'Valid credentials'
fix: Create an App Store Connect API key (Users and Access > Integrations) and upload it in RevenueCat with Key ID and Issuer ID

title: RevenueCat has the iOS app connected with a valid in-app purchase key
evidence: RevenueCat Apps lists 'Pexi (App Store)' app877a77e1c2, bundle com.getpexi.app; In-app purchase key configuration: file H45CN4BUF3.p8 'Valid credentials'

title: Restoring purchases on another device transfers access to the new user
evidence: RevenueCat Project Settings > Handling multiple app user IDs: 'Transferring purchases seen on multiple App User IDs: Transfer to new App User ID' ('Use a different behavior for sandbox' option shown)

title: RevenueCat default offering has two packages and the iOS SDK is live
evidence: Offerings: 'default  The standard set of packages  2 packages  Oct 10, 2026'. Apps page SDK table: iOS purchases-capacitor 13.6.0 (100.00%). Overview: New Customers 123 last 28 days, Active Customers 2, Active Subscriptions 0, Revenue $0, 'No live transactions to show'
fix: none (no live purchase has happened yet)

title: Apple Small Business Program start date is not recorded in RevenueCat
evidence: RevenueCat Apps > Pexi (App Store) > Apple Small Business Program: Start date field shows placeholder 'YYYY-MM-DD' (empty). Whether Pexi is enrolled with Apple (15% commission instead of 30%) not visible, App Store Connect not signed in
fix: If enrolled with Apple, enter the effective date in RevenueCat so reported revenue matches; if not enrolled, apply at developer.apple.com/app-store/small-business-program

title: RevenueCat Offerings page lists the test store products beside the real ones
evidence: Products page: 'Test Store' group lists Lifetime, Yearly, Monthly (created Oct 10, 2026) with 1 entitlement each; Play Store group is empty ('Add products'). Sandbox access set to 'Anybody'
fix: Confirm the shipped build uses the iOS public key and the iOS products only; Play Store has no products yet if Android is planned
